title: Short title, extent, commencement and application
content: This Act may be called the Companies Act, 2013. It extends to the whole of India.

title: Definitions
content: Defines key legal terms under the Act: Sec 2(20) Company, Sec 2(68) Private Company, Sec 2(71) Public Company, Sec 2(62) One Person Company, Sec 2(46) Holding Company, Sec 2(87) Subsidiary Company.

title: Formation of company
content: A company may be formed for any lawful purpose by 7 or more persons (Public), 2 or more persons (Private), or 1 person (OPC).

title: Section 3A: Members severally liable in certain cases
content: If the number of members falls below statutory minimum and business continues for more than 6 months, remaining members are personally liable.

title: Memorandum of Association
content: Contains Name clause, Registered office clause, Object clause, Liability clause, Share Capital clause, and Subscription clause.

title: Articles of Association
content: Contains regulations for management of the company and entrenchment provisions.

title: Incorporation of company
content: Procedure for filing SPICe+ forms with ROC, declarations by professionals, and issuance of Certificate of Incorporation (COI).

title: Registered office of company
content: A company shall, within 30 days of incorporation, have a registered office capable of receiving communications.

title: Alteration of memorandum
content: Special Resolution required. Shift of registered office outside state requires Central Government (RD) approval.

title: Alteration of articles
content: Requires Special Resolution. Conversion of public to private requires Tribunal/RD approval.

title: Offer or invitation for subscription of securities on private placement
content: Offer to maximum 200 persons in a financial year. All monies to be paid through banking channels.

title: Kinds of share capital
content: Equity share capital (with equal voting rights or differential rights) and Preference share capital.

title: Prohibition on issue of shares at discount
content: Any share issued at a discount shall be void, except as sweat equity under Section 54.

title: Issue of sweat equity shares
content: Issued to directors or employees at a discount or for consideration other than cash for providing know-how or IPR.

title: Further issue of share capital
content: Rights Issue to existing shareholders, ESOPs by Special Resolution, or Preferential Allotment.

title: Power of company to purchase its own securities (Buy-back)
content: Buyback up to 10% by Board resolution, up to 25% by Special Resolution of total paid-up equity and free reserves.

title: Debentures
content: Option to issue convertible/non-convertible debentures. Creation of Debenture Redemption Reserve (DRR) and Debenture Trustee mandatory for public issues.

title: Power to nominate securities holders
content: Every holder of securities may nominate a person to whom securities shall vest in event of death (Form SH-13).

title: Prohibition on acceptance of deposits from public
content: Prohibits accepting deposits from public unless complying with Chapter V rules and passing resolution.

title: Repayment of deposits accepted before commencement
content: Filing statement in Form DPT-1 and repaying deposits within prescribed timelines or extensions by NCLT.

title: Damages for fraud in deposit acceptance
content: Where deposits accepted with intent to defraud depositors, officers are personally liable without limitation under Section 447.

title: Acceptance of deposits by eligible companies
content: Eligible public company (Net worth ≥ ₹100 Cr or Turnover ≥ ₹500 Cr) obtaining credit rating may accept deposits from public.

title: Duty to register charges
content: Duty to register charge with ROC within 30 days of creation (Form CHG-1/CHG-9).

title: Register of members
content: Maintenance of MGT-1 (Members), MGT-2 (Debentures), MGT-3 (Foreign register).

title: Annual return
content: Every company shall prepare Annual Return in Form MGT-7/MGT-7A within 60 days of AGM.

title: Annual general meeting
content: AGM to be held every year within 6 months from FY close. Max gap between two AGMs is 15 months.

title: Calling of extraordinary general meeting
content: Board may call EGM, or members holding at least 1/10th of paid-up share capital may requisition an EGM.

title: Notice of meeting
content: Minimum 21 clear days written notice required for general meetings (shorter notice with 95% consent).

title: Quorum for meetings
content: Public Co: 5 (if <1000 members), 15 (1000-5000), 30 (>5000). Private Co: 2 members personally present.

title: Voting through electronic means
content: Mandatory for listed companies and companies having 1000 or more shareholders.

title: Declaration of dividend
content: Dividend declared out of current FY profits, past profits, or Govt funds. Transfer to unpaid dividend account within 7 days if unpaid after 30 days.

title: Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR)
content: Applicable to Co with Net Worth ≥ 500 Cr, Turnover ≥ 1000 Cr, or Net Profit ≥ 5 Cr. Must spend 2% of average net profits of preceding 3 FYs.

title: Appointment of auditors
content: Statutory auditor appointed at 1st AGM for a tenure of 5 years (1 term of 5 yrs for individual, 2 terms for firm).

title: Company to have Board of Directors
content: Min directors: 3 (Public), 2 (Private), 1 (OPC). Max: 15 (can exceed by Special Resolution). Mandatory 1 Woman Director & Independent Directors for listed/eligible public cos.

title: Meetings of Board
content: First BM within 30 days of incorporation. Min 4 Board meetings per year with gap not exceeding 120 days.

title: Loans and investment by company
content: Limits: 60% of paid-up capital + free reserves + securities premium OR 100% of free reserves + securities premium, whichever is more.

title: Related party transactions
content: Requires Board approval/Audit Committee approval; beyond specified thresholds requires Ordinary Resolution.

title: Appointment of Key Managerial Personnel (KMP)
content: Mandatory for listed cos & public cos with paid-up capital ≥ 10 Cr to have MD/CEO, CS, and CFO.

title: Punishment for fraud
content: Imprisonment from 6 months up to 10 years, and fine up to 3 times the amount involved in fraud.
